bullets.text: Oura Ring 4 Ceramic Shines - **Oura**'s latest smart ring combines style with wear-resistant zirconia ceramic for a sleek look.
Pixel 10 Pro Fold's Durability - **Google**'s latest foldable phone features an IP68 rating and a new gearless hinge for sturdiness.
Apple's Developer Lawsuit Loss - **Apple** faces potential damages of up to £2B after losing a lawsuit over app commission rates.
Apple Watch Blood Oxygen Update - **Apple**'s redesigned Blood Oxygen feature faces scrutiny from the ITC due to patent issues.
WhatsApp's Third-Party Integration - **Meta** prepares to launch third-party chat integration on **WhatsApp** in compliance with EU regulations.
Disney Channels Return to YouTube TV - **Disney** and **YouTube** resolve their dispute, restoring channels including ESPN for subscribers.
Apple Wallet's Digital ID Feature - **Apple** launches a Digital ID feature in Wallet, enhancing user privacy and security.
OpenAI's Revenue Sharing with Microsoft - Leaked documents reveal **OpenAI** pays **Microsoft** significant revenue shares, highlighting financial ties.
Apple Tightens App Review Guidelines - **Apple** introduces stricter rules to prevent apps from sharing personal data with third-party AI.
Tesla's Safety Report Released - **Tesla** publishes detailed safety data for its Full Self-Driving software, addressing transparency concerns.
